home.infrastructure.title: Build trackable member participation infrastructure for enterprises
home.infrastructure.body: Timeblock helps brands, event organizers, retail channels and partner platforms manage member missions, event participation, internal point rewards, affiliate exposure, redemption records and QR scan behavior in one place. Enterprises can use Business plans to create events, publish partner missions, track member participation and connect existing systems through API / Webhook.
home.feature.events.label: Event management platform
home.feature.events.title: Enterprise event operations
home.feature.events.body: Create brand events, ticket events, member events and TBQR scan events.
home.feature.points.label: Internal points system
home.feature.points.title: Missions and internal point rewards
home.feature.points.body: Issue platform internal points according to member participation behavior and keep clear records.
home.feature.ledger.label: Activity ledger
home.feature.ledger.title: Activity ledger and audit
home.feature.ledger.body: Keep audit trails for important actions to support operations and governance.
home.feature.shop.label: Brand member operations
home.feature.shop.title: Featured shop cooperation

home.feature.tbqr.title: TBQR entry points

home.feature.api.title: API / Webhook integration
home.feature.api.body: Let enterprise systems consume Timeblock member participation data.
home.partners.title: Partner brands and business accounts
home.partners.body: Show connected or configurable business accounts, partner brands and ecosystem partners so enterprise visitors can understand Timeblock commercial cooperation scenarios.
home.partners.default_description: Connected to Timeblock business account showcase settings.
home.partners.empty: No partner brand has been configured yet. Add a business account or brand logo in admin.
home.event_sources.title: Three event sources for different participation scenarios
home.event_sources.body: Timeblock separates platform events, business events and member events so enterprises and members can clearly understand each event source, rule and participation path.
home.event_sources.platform.label: Platform event
home.event_sources.platform.title: Platform events
home.event_sources.platform.body: Created by Timeblock official operators for platform missions, official events, AI usage allowance events, and member benefit events.
home.event_sources.business.label: Business event
home.event_sources.business.title: Business events
home.event_sources.business.body: Brands, stores and enterprises can publish cooperation events, ticket events, brand missions and TBQR scan events through Business plans.
home.event_sources.member.label: Member event
home.event_sources.member.title: Member events
home.event_sources.member.body: Members can view, join and track eligible events, or use platform internal points for event tickets according to event rules.
home.shop_sources.title: Three shop entry points with clear cooperation and redemption boundaries
home.shop_sources.body: Affiliate content and internal point redemption remain separate: affiliate products lead to external partner platforms, while point redemption follows an independent flow and is not mixed with in-platform checkout.
home.shop_sources.platform.label: Platform shop
home.shop_sources.platform.title: Platform shop
home.shop_sources.platform.body: Managed by Timeblock official operators to display curated platform content, official cooperation content and configured event products.
home.shop_sources.business.label: Business shop
home.shop_sources.business.title: Business shop
home.shop_sources.business.body: Enterprise brands can display cooperation products, affiliate products and event products that link to external partner platforms or selected event pages.
home.shop_sources.member.label: Member shop
home.shop_sources.member.title: Member shop
home.shop_sources.member.body: Members can browse dedicated curated content, view eligible products or use platform internal points for selected items according to rules.
home.final.title: Connect your brand to the Timeblock member ecosystem
home.final.body: Enterprises do not only publish products or events; they connect into Timeblock mission, event, shop, internal points and activity ledger infrastructure. Through Business plans, brands can build member participation flows, track event performance and gradually connect API / Webhook and TBQR scenarios.
home.safety.body: Platform internal points are Timeblock internal benefit points and can only be used under platform rules for mission rewards, event tickets, AI chat allowance and selected redemption items; they have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn, transferred or exchanged for cash.
